title: RealPatch: A Statistical Matching Framework for Model Patching with Real Samples
reasoning: The paper focuses on technical methods to mitigate subgroup performance gaps and dataset leakage in machine learning models, primarily in computer vision. While it touches upon fairness and transparency in its acknowledgments regarding funding (ERC Starting Grant for "Bayesian Models and Algorithms for Fairness and Transparency"), it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as a core component of its research.
